description: This file provides kernel thread support functions for Zephyr RTOS, including thread creation, management, state querying, and context switching instrumentation.

methods.name: k_thread_foreach
methods.description: Iterates over all active threads, calling a user-provided callback.

methods.name: k_thread_foreach_unlocked
methods.description: Iterates over all active threads without acquiring the monitor lock.

methods.name: z_thread_essential_set
methods.description: Marks the current thread as essential to system operation.

methods.name: z_thread_essential_clear
methods.description: Marks the current thread as not essential.

methods.name: z_is_thread_essential
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is marked as essential.

methods.name: k_thread_name_set
methods.description: Sets the name of a thread.

methods.name: k_thread_name_get
methods.description: Gets the name of a thread.

methods.name: k_thread_name_copy
methods.description: Copies the thread's name into a buffer.

methods.name: k_thread_state_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a thread's state.

methods.name: k_thread_stack_space_get
methods.description: Returns the amount of unused stack space for a thread.

methods.name: k_thread_runtime_stats_get
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics for a specific thread.

methods.name: k_thread_runtime_stats_all_get
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics for all threads.
